mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, D.BOOKSET_NAME booksetName, B.SCH_ID schId, B.SCH_NAME schName, B.SCHEME_TYPE schemeType, B.IS_DEFAULT isDefault, C.ERROR_NUMBER errorNumber, C.MY_START_ROW_NO myStartRowNo, C.OTHERSIDE_START_ROW_NO othersideStartRowNo FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN A INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO B ON B.SCH_ID = A.SCHEME_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO_DETAIL C ON C.SCH_ID = A.SCHEME_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET D ON D.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.BOOKSET_SCHEME_ID = #{booksetSchemeId}
SELECT BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, GEN_DETSUB_FLAG AS genDetsubFlag FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
select BOOKSET_ID as id, BOOKSET_NAME as text from BOK_BOOKSET where STATUS = 'E' order by BOOKSET_ID

SELECT A.SEQ_NO AS seqNo, A.SCHEME_ID AS schemeId, A.BLOCK_TYPE AS blockType, A.MY_COL_ID AS myColId, A.MY_COL_REMARK AS myColRemark, A.OTHERSIDE_COL_ID AS othersideColId, A.OTHERSIDE_COL_REMARK AS othersideColRemark FROM BOK_SCHEME_STRUCT_CONFIG A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN B ON B.SCHEME_ID = A.SCHEME_ID where A.SCHEME_ID = #{schId} AND B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT DISTINCT A.SCHEME_ID AS schemeId, A.MY_SUBJECT_ID AS mySubjectId, C.SUBJECT_NAME AS mySubjectName, C.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG AS myIsGenSubs, A.IS_GEN_SUBS AS isGenSubs, A.OTHERSIDE_SUBJECT_ID AS othersideSubjectId, A.OTHERSIDE_SUBJECT_NAME AS othersideSubjectName, A.BLOCK_TYPE AS blockType FROM BOK_SCHEME_SUBJECT_CONFIG A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN B ON B.SCHEME_ID = A.SCHEME_ID AND B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND C.SUBJECT_NO = A.MY_SUBJECT_ID WHERE A.SCHEME_ID = #{schId} ORDER BY A.MY_SUBJECT_ID ASC

SELECT DISTINCT A.SCHEME_ID AS schemeId, A.IS_GEN_SUBS AS IsGenSubs, A.OTHERSIDE_SUBJECT_ID AS othersideSubjectId, A.OTHERSIDE_SUBJECT_NAME AS othersideSubjectName, A.MY_NATURE_ID AS myNatureId, A.BLOCK_TYPE AS blockType, D.SUBJECT_NATURE_NAME AS myNatureName FROM BOK_SCHEME_NATURE_CONFIG A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN B ON B.SCHEME_ID = A.SCHEME_ID AND B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_STANDARD_NATURE D ON D.ACCT_STANDARD_ID = C.ACCT_STANDARD AND D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = A.MY_NATURE_ID WHERE A.SCHEME_ID = #{schId} ORDER BY A.OTHERSIDE_SUBJECT_ID ASC

SELECT A.SCHEME_ID AS schemeId, A.MY_ASSET_ID AS myAssetId, A.OTHERSIDE_ASSET_ID AS othersideAssetId FROM BOK_SCHEME_ASSET_CONFIG A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN B ON B.SCHEME_ID = A.SCHEME_ID WHERE A.SCHEME_ID = #{schId} AND B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
